description: Get a presigned HTTPS URL to download the completed output file. Call after get_job_status returns 'complete'. URL expires in 24 hours.

job_id.description: Job ID from transcode_video, transcode_from_url, any convert tool, or any transcribe tool.

name: get_download_url

download_url.description: Presigned HTTPS GET URL for the output file. Valid for 24 hours.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the download URL expires.

filename.description: Suggested filename for the downloaded file including extension.

size_bytes.description: File size of the output in bytes.
